text: Ezra Chatterton (a.k.a. Ephoenix, 1996–2008) was an World of Warcraft player from California, playing with his father Micah on the Norgannon US server. He had been diagnosed with brain cancer in spring 2007 and, fulfilling his dream of creating a character for World of Warcraft, Ezra visited Blizzard Entertainment's offices through the Make-a-Wish Foundation. He worked with Tigole in creating Ahab Wheathoof, a tauren farmer looking for his missing dog Kyle, in Kyle's Gone Missing!; he also provided the voice. Ezra also received the world first Ashes of Al'ar - the phoenix was Ezra's personal symbol, as well as his middle name - and created the Merciless Gladiator's Crossbow of the Phoenix. E

Faction pride is the sentiment of pride or patriotism toward one of the playable factions: the Alliance and the Horde. Faction pride can lead to friendly rivalries, expressions of patriotic feeling, and on occasion more aggressive conflicts between players, such as on forums. Faction pride is often expressed in the battle-cry of each faction - "For the Alliance!" or "For the Horde!". Faction pride and a healthy rivalry between the Alliance and the Horde was one of the earliest design goals for World of Warcraft, and Blizzard has often encouraged faction pride through events and activities such as the Mists of Pandaria launch events. The Faction Assault on Drustvar is part of the Faction Assaults on Kul Tiras. Drustvar, a territory of the Alliance, is the traditional seat of the Waycrest dynasty, and provides significant resources to the Kul Tiran military, making it a strategic target. In response to the initial Horde attack, the Alliance would dispatch the Light-blessed Purified led by Vindicator Ralgala to defend the area and its people. Most of the fighting would be in western Drustvar, and ultimately center around Arom's Stand, with the Alliance fortifying the position against a Horde aerial bombardment and siege.

It gathered Troll players with the purpose of making Blizzard Entertainment fix numerous items' skins' bugs on the Troll model (as an example, the tier 2 Rogue hood does not cover their large nose). Their leaders were the bloodthirsty trolls Finntroll (Sook) and Lama (Jabzor), which lead "terrorist" forces ready to get their claims heard. Their motto: Trollidos unidos jamas seran vencidos! The Falfarren River runs northeast to southwest across Ashenvale, and is approximately the dividing line between the night elven territory under Astranaar to the west, and the orcish territory under Splintertree Post to the east. It is not a terribly deep or wide river, though rainfall can cause it to swell. Several aggressive bog beasts can be found roaming below the surface of the river at sections around Felfire Hill. During the Cataclysm new bridges were built along the river. The water of the river originates from the slopes of Mount Hyjal, and passes through a series of waterfalls into the lake at Xavian, before it runs between Splintertree and Night Run southwest. Fallen Crewmates are deceased pirates located in the Wailing Tideway in Tiragarde Sound.
Fairweather's Fine Enchantments is an enchanting shop located in the Tradewinds Market in Boralus. It is run by Emily Fairweather.
__NOTOC__ Fallen Guardians of the Dream are druids found in Malorne's Nightmare.
The Fall is the pit where blood troll sacrifices are thrown in as offerings to the loa Hir'eek. The loa's spawn cover the cave's ceiling.
The Faithsworn item collection is awarded from completing world quests in Darkshore during the War of the Thorns. Though not a proper set (with no set bonuses), all nine pieces share a name:

The Faithless, also known as the Faithless empire or the sethrak empire, (sometimes capitalized as the Sethrak Empire) are a force of militant sethrak led by Emperor Korthek. Having turned away from the sethrak's loa Sethraliss, the Faithless and their emperor seek to conquer all of Zandalar and will not stop until they have conquered the world. They have allied themselves with the forces of General Jakra'zet of the Zanchuli Council with the shared goal of breaking the seal on the great pyramid of Atul'Aman and unleashing the monstrosity within in order to conquer Zuldazar.
Faithless Weapon Racks are located in the Crater of Conquerors in Vol'dun.
Faithless Scimitars are looted from Faithless Weapon Racks during Ready to Riot.
The Faithless Wrangler is a dead sethrak located next to Kiro just south of the Feeding Pits in Vol'dun. Kiro apparently killed the sethrak in order to hijack their Battle Krolusk.
Faithless Trapper's Spear is located at Rakjan's Peak in Vol'dun.
The Faithsworn Mitts were awarded from Darkshore world quests and looted from War Supply Chests during the War of the Thorns.
Fake Eye Patches are primarily obtained by Pick Pocketing pirates in Kul Tiras.
Faithless Wardens are Faithless sethrak located on the Terrace of the Devoted in Vol'dun.
Faithless Sentries are Faithless sethrak located on the Terrace of the Devoted as well as on the road southeast of the terrace in Vol'dun. Some of them are mounted on krolusks.

Faithless Skycallers are Faithless sethrak located at the Terrace of the Devoted, the Temple Incursion, the Thundering Terrace, the Skycallers' Spire, the Slithering Gulch, and the Serpent's Maw in Vol'dun.
Faithless Ravagers are Faithless sethrak located at the Serpent's Maw and the Terrace of the Devoted in Vol'dun.
Faithless Aggressors are Faithless sethrak located at the Serpent's Maw and the Terrace of the Devoted in Vol'dun.
Faithless Sandscouts are Faithless sethrak located at the Serpent's Maw and on the road southeast of the Terrace of the Devoted in Vol'dun.
Faithless Defenders are Faithless sethrak located in the Temple Incursion in Vol'dun.

Faithless Warbringers are Faithless sethrak located in the Temple Incursion in Vol'dun. Some of them are normally mounted on krolusks but dismount when attacked. One Warbringer is found locked inside a cage next to Zareen in the Sanctuary of the Devoted.
Faithless Menders are Faithless sethrak located at the Serpent's Maw and the Temple Incursion in Vol'dun.
Faithless Bonepickers are Faithless sethrak located in the Temple Incursion in Vol'dun.

Faithless Stormforgers are Faithless sethrak located in the Temple Incursion in Vol'dun, where they can often be seen tinkering with weapon racks or working on weapons at the small anvil in the east part of the incursion.
The Faithless Egg-Tenders are two Faithless sethrak standing next to a pool filled with large eggs in the Temple Incursion in Vol'dun.

Faithless Champions are Faithless sethrak located at the Serpent's Maw and the Thundering Terrace in Vol'dun. The ones at the Serpent's Maw roam the area mounted on krolusks but dismount upon reaching around 50% health. Two Champions guard the huge stair in the center of the Thundering Terrace leading up to the Skycallers' Spire, while others patrol around the west and east parts of the terrace and the main bridge spanning the Slithering Gulch.
Faithless Guardians are Faithless sethrak located in the eastern part of the Skycallers' Spire in Vol'dun.
Faithless Commanders are Faithless sethrak located in the eastern part of the Skycallers' Spire in Vol'dun. They are normally mounted on krolusks but dismount when attacked.
Faithless Guardians are Faithless sethrak located in the Sacred Sands and the Skycallers' Spire in Vol'dun.

Faithless Spireguards are Faithless sethrak standing guard in various spots around the Sacred Sands and the central part of the Skycallers' Spire in Vol'dun. A few of them are seen manning Sethrak Cannons on the westernmost edge of the Sacred Sands.
Faithless Scrollkeepers are Faithless sethrak located around the Sacred Sands in Vol'dun.
Faithless Deadeyes are Faithless sethrak located around the Feeding Pits in Vol'dun.
Faithless Beastlords are Faithless sethrak located around the Feeding Pits in Vol'dun.
Faithless Suppressors are Faithless sethrak located in and around Crawg Tamer Traskniss' cave at the Feeding Pits in Vol'dun.
Fallen Glaives were glaives found in the Ruins of Auberdine in Darkshore during the War of the Thorns. They were used during Blunt the Spikes / Pruning the Thorns and gave a buff.

Faithless Watchers are Faithless sethrak that roam the lower parts of the Slithering Gulch in Vol'dun. They are normally mounted on krolusks but dismount when attacked. Some, but not all, can see through Stealth and invisibility.
Faithless Stalkers are Faithless sethrak located at the bottom of the Slithering Gulch in Vol'dun, standing in Stealth or tinkering with various objects in stalls.

Faithless Citizens are civilian Faithless sethrak located throughout the bottom of the Slithering Gulch in Vol'dun. They are usually seen standing and talking with other citizens or attending slave auctions held by Faithless Dealers.

Faithless Dealers are Faithless sethrak located throughout the bottom of the Slithering Gulch in Vol'dun. Many can be seen working at tables and fire pits in the gulch's market stalls; others, however, are instead holding slave markets at , , and , auctioning off Vulpera Slaves or Tortollan Slaves to groups of Faithless Citizens. If one such Dealer is killed, the slaves will escape to freedom.

Faithless Centurions are Faithless sethrak that roam the southeastern cliffs of the Slithering Gulch and the northeastern outskirts of the Serpent's Maw in Vol'dun. They are normally mounted on krolusks but dismount upon reaching around 55% health. Several dead, unmounted Faithless Centurions are lying around Bwoljin's Fall, apparently killed by Defiant Scrappers.
Faithless Dervishes are Faithless sethrak located around the southeastern cliffs of the Slithering Gulch in Vol'dun.
Faithless Gunners are Faithless sethrak manning large cannons around the southeastern cliffs of the Slithering Gulch in Vol'dun.
The Faithless Flayer is a Faithless sethrak sitting in front of a fire pit in the eastern part of the Serpent's Maw camp in Vol'dun.
__NOTOC__ Faella is a draenei located in Boralus Harbor in Boralus.

Faithless Raiders are Faithless sethrak that periodically spawn to deliver a satchel, a Captured Exile, or a Captured Krolusk to the Crater of Conquerors in Vol'dun. Each case displays slightly different behavior: *The Raiders carrying satchels will run into the crater and drop their object off at the stash in the center of the area, before running back out and despawning. *The Raiders dragging Captured Exiles will leave their prisoner near some cages just inside the crater's entrance before running out and despawning. Faithless Oppressors are Faithless sethrak located in the Crater of Conquerors and on one of the southeastern cliffs of the Slithering Gulch in Vol'dun. Some of the ones in the Crater of Conquerors can be seen overseeing the Maimed Krolusks or beating a Captured Exile.
Faithless Slavers are Faithless sethrak that roam the Crater of Conquerors in Vol'dun. Several can be seen sparring against training dummies.
Faithless Auditors are Faithless sethrak located in the Crater of Conquerors in Vol'dun. Some of them are normally mounted on krolusks but dismount when attacked.
Fallen Cultists are deceased humans and orcs located at the Gates of Sothann in Mount Hyjal.
Falcon's Roost is an inn located in Falconhurst in Drustvar. The establishment is run by Alisha Darkwater.
